accepted.label: Laplace Criterion
accepted.description: Decision rule that assumes all states of nature are equally likely, computing the average payoff for each alternative and selecting the highest average.
coverage_criteria: Calculate average payoffs from a payoff table
Determine the optimal alternative using this criterion
accepted.merge_rationale: Both candidates present the identical teachable idea of Laplace criterion under equal likelihood; differences in lesson context and depth labels do not add materially different student behavior. The criterion is applied in both by calculating average payoff and selecting the highest.
